metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Laos on February 3, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - FIRMS data: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily) or "MODIS/061/MCD14DL" (daily fire detections) - Better option: FIRMS collection "FIRMS" which provides fire detections - Actually, best is: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MCD14DL" - Let me use: MODIS/061/MCD14DL (MODIS Terra+Aqua combined daily fire product) - Date: February 3, 2018 (single day) - Location: Cambodia vs Laos country boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - Fire detection products have confidence levels - Filter for fires with nominal or high confidence (confidence >= 50 or use FireMask band) - Count total fire pixels in each country 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images found for the date: C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels after processing: C2 (but fire data should have pixels) - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 - If both countries have valid counts (including 0): Compare and answer A (Cambodia > Laos) or B (Cambodia <= Laos) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')) .geometry(); const laos = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Laos')) .geometry(); const date = '2018-02-03'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire Daily product const fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD14DL') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); const colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No fire detection data for 2018-02-03.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire detections const fireImg = fireCol.mosaic(); // MaxFRP band or FireMask band - use FireMask (values: 0-9, where 7-9 are fires) // Actually MCD14DL has MaxFRP, but let's check available bands // MCD14DL has: MaxFRP (fire radiative power), sample (number of fire pixels) // We'll use MaxFRP > 0 to indicate fire presence const fireMask = fireImg.select('MaxFRP').gt(0); // Count fires in Cambodia const cambodiaStats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cambodiaFires = cambodiaStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); // Count fires in Laos const laosStats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: laos, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const laosFires = laosStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Cambodia fire detections: ${cambodiaFires}`); console.log(`Laos fire detections: ${laosFires}`); if (cambodiaFires === null || laosFires === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(cambodiaFires) || isNaN(laosFires)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Valid results - compare if (cambodiaFires > laosFires) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
